login.description: VIAN is an open video annotation application. Some of its features are:

features.electronBrowser: Works in the browser or via Electron as a desktop application

tooltips.shotBoundaryDetection: Automatically detect shot boundaries in the video
tooltips.loadSubtitles: Import a subtitle file and add it as a track
tooltips.generateScreenshots: Capture screenshots from the video at a set interval
tooltips.manageVocabulary: Create and edit vocabularies for structured annotation
tooltips.switchToLightMode: Switch the interface to light mode
tooltips.switchToDarkMode: Switch the interface to dark mode
tooltips.layout: Change the panel layout of the workspace
tooltips.shortcuts: Show the list of keyboard shortcuts

shotBoundaryDetection.title: Shot Boundary Detection
shotBoundaryDetection.description: This detects the shot boundaries in the video automatically and adds them as a new timeline. It runs as a background job that can take a while; you can cancel it from the job list.

generateScreenshots.title: Generate Screenshots
generateScreenshots.description: Create a screenshot every N seconds
generateScreenshots.perShotLabel: Ensure at least one screenshot per shot

tracks.description: Choose the tracks you want to export. Formats that support your selection are enabled on the right.

disabledReasons.noSelection: Select at least one track first.
disabledReasons.shotsOnly: Only supports shots tracks, with no other track types selected.
disabledReasons.csvUnsupported: Requires at least one shots track. Scalar tracks aren't supported (screenshot tracks are fine).

elan.title: ELAN (.eaf)
elan.description: Export the selected shots track(s) as an ELAN annotation file, including free-text and vocabulary tag annotations.

csv.title: CSV
csv.description: Export the selected shots track(s) as a CSV file.

csvScreenshots.title: CSV with Screenshots
csvScreenshots.description: Export the selected shots track(s) as a CSV file, bundled with the linked screenshots into a .zip archive.

mediapkg.title: Tracks (.mediapkg)
mediapkg.description: Export the selected tracks as a MAVA .mediapkg package, documented in the

project.description: Export the whole project, including the video reference and all timelines, as a .zip archive that can be opened again in VIAN.

importMediapkg.title: Import .mediapkg
importMediapkg.description: Choose a .mediapkg file, then select which tracks to import into this project. Imported tracks whose name matches an existing track are renamed with "(Imported)" appended.

leaveProject.title: Leave Project
leaveProject.description: There are still jobs running for this project. Leaving now will cancel them.

timelines.unlinkVocabularyWarning: This track's vocabulary annotations will be lost. This cannot be undone.

vocabularyDialogList.deleteWarningText: Deleting this item also removes any annotations that use it. This cannot be undone.

vocabularyDialogListItem.deleteWarningText: Deleting this tag also removes any annotations that use it. This cannot be undone.

shotDetail.lockHelp: Locking a segment prevents its deletion, movement, and changing the annotation.

videoPlayer.playbackRateHelp:
Playback Rate (KL System)

K: Stop and reset speed
L: Play forward

Press L multiple times to increase speed, or click to pick a speed
videoPlayer.videoCouldNotBeLoaded: The video could not be loaded. It may have been moved or deleted. You can ignore this or choose a new video location.

tooltips.setInPoint: Mark the start of a new segment at the playhead (i)
tooltips.setOutPoint: Mark the end of the pending segment at the playhead (o)
tooltips.duplicateTrack: Create a copy of this track
tooltips.duplicateTrackShotsOnly: Create a copy of this track with the shot boundaries but no annotations
tooltips.duplicateTrackWithAnnotations: Create a copy of this track including its annotations
tooltips.deleteTrack: Permanently remove this track and all its segments
tooltips.renameTrack: Change the name of this track
tooltips.linkVocabularyToTrack: Associate this track with a vocabulary for annotation
tooltips.unlinkVocabularyFromTrack: Remove the vocabulary link from this track
tooltips.trackHeight: Adjust the height of the tracks
tooltips.hideTrack: Remove this track from the main list
tooltips.showTrack: Restore this track to the main list

timelineCanvas.moveWarning: Segment cannot be moved here as it would overlap with another segment.

contextMenu.split: Split this segment at play head

playback.playForward: Play forward, press repeatedly to increase speed

segmentation.rangeSelect: Range select segments between anchor and click

shotMarking.setInPoint: Set in-point of a new segment at the playhead

annotation.commitAnnotation: Commit annotation text / save edited vocabulary field
